name: Napoleonic Wars
description: France's bid for European hegemony under Napoleon: mass conscript armies, the Continental System, the catastrophic Russian campaign, and final defeat at Waterloo — settled at Vienna into a century's balance of power.

name: American Civil War
description: The Union's war against the secessionist slaveholding Confederacy — the first great industrial war of railways, telegraphs, ironclads, and trenches — killing some 750,000 and ending American slavery.
